gen-gf-warnes-gf-strait: Warnes draws its letters with ink strokes that taper out before touching, stretched wide and spaced generously across the line. Strait's round lowercase bowls keep the sans friendly beneath it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-tiny5: Stitched-thread outlines, all one stroke width, give Warnes a bold, stretched-out look. And Tiny5 sits below it in a tall, tidy sans whose ascenders seem to shrink, so text feels compact and friendly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-truculenta: Warnes has ink strokes that taper out before they touch, with loose, stretched spacing between letters. Truculenta packs its sans-serif into a compact line, yet its rounded forms stay open, so reading feels snug but approachable.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-ubuntu: Warnes strokes look drawn with one fixed nib, then taper out before touching, stretched wide with spacious tracking. Ubuntu's lofty lowercase gives the pair its strongest quality: a clear gap in height.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-viga: Viga reads as a plain sans, with capitals barely taller than their neighbors and no hairlines. Make Warnes small and its tapered, stretched strokes lose their bold presence, while Viga holds up fine at larger sizes.
gen-gf-warnes-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads as a geometric sans, its ribbon-like strokes leaving counters wide open. Warnes is best at expressive display, with tapered ink strokes and stretched spacing, while Space Grotesk is best for steady, moderate-height lowercase text.
gen-irish-grover-gf-cal-sans: Irish Grover makes words look sturdy and large, with tall lowercase and softly varied strokes. Cal Sans is the one for text, a plain sans with a single stroke width and short ascenders.
gen-irish-grover-gf-epunda-sans: Irish Grover's tall lowercase makes words look sturdy and large, with open throats on a, c, e, and s. Epunda Sans follows in sans-serif with oversized counters, so big, short headings stay lively.
gen-irish-grover-gf-farro: Irish Grover has tall, sturdy lowercase with bowls that swell only slightly where widest. And Farro, a plain sans, keeps a tube-like thickness through every bend, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-fragment-mono: Playful and organic, Irish Grover has tall, open lowercase. It handles big, sturdy words best, while Fragment Mono, a monospace with wire-like monoline strokes, lays letters out like nails on a ruler.
